frames.title: Lesson 114 · take something into consideration — use

body: **Foco:** take something into consideration — uso.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar take something into consideration em argumentos de um editorial sobre educação.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: ponto de vista das partes interessadas

blocks.title: Editorial: What Schools Should Take into Consideration
paras: When ministers redesign the exam system, they must **take** pupils’ circumstances **into consideration**. A child who studies in a crowded flat is not on a level field with one who has a private room. Yet league tables **take** such differences **into account** too rarely.

**Taking into consideration** the wishes of teachers would also help; so would **taking** local needs **into account**. A fair system **is one that** is **taken into consideration** by those it serves. We ask the minister to **take** this editorial **into consideration** before the new law is drafted.

items.q: The editors say league tables often consider pupils’ circumstances.
A child with a private room has an advantage.
The law has already been approved.

head: Uso
Exemplo
rows: We ask you to **take** this **into consideration**.
League tables do not **take** it **into account**.
Pupils’ needs must **be taken into consideration**.

blocks.body: Para pedir ou criticar, use **take X into consideration** (ou **into account**). Com objeto longo ou oração, ele vem **depois**: *Take into consideration that…*
Evite *take in consideration* e *take into considerations*: a forma é **into consideration** (singular).

items.s: We ask you to take this ___ consideration. (into)
League tables do not take it into ___ . (account)
___ local needs into consideration is wise. (Take, -ing)
Pupils’ needs must be ___ into consideration. (take)

body: **Take something on board** — Acatar algo
**Bear in mind** — Ter em mente
**Give due weight to…** — Dar o devido peso a…
**Pay heed to…** — Dar ouvidos a…
**Turn a deaf ear to…** — Fazer ouvidos moucos a…
**Move the goalposts** — Mudar as regras no meio do jogo
**Hear both sides** — Ouvir os dois lados
**Think things through** — Pensar bem nas coisas
**We will take them into account, yes.** — Levaremos em conta, sim.
**Then why do league tables ignore them?** — Então por que os rankings as ignoram?
**Will the ministry take pupils’ circumstances into consideration?** — O ministério levará as circunstâncias dos alunos em consideração?

blocks.title: Press briefing
lines: Will the ministry take pupils’ circumstances into consideration?
O ministério levará as circunstâncias dos alunos em consideração?
We will take them into account, yes.
Then why do league tables ignore them?

That is something we must take into consideration.
Isso é algo que devemos levar em consideração.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.q: Ask someone formally to consider your point.
prompts.model: We ask you to take this into consideration.
League tables do not take pupils’ circumstances into account.

prompts.q: Give a reason using taking … into consideration.
prompts.model: Taking local needs into consideration would improve the system.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence editorial paragraph in which you urge a decision-maker to take two things into consideration.
blocks.model: We urge the minister to take two facts into consideration. First, pupils start from different positions. Second, teachers are already overloaded. Taking both into account would make the reform fairer. A law that ignores them will fail. We hope our request will be taken into consideration.

items.why: **level playing field** = campo de jogo nivelado.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
